text: RVB (Wildberries&Russ, the merged Wildberries/Russ company) is 65% owned by Wildberries founder Tatyana Kim; the remaining 35% belongs to the structures of outdoor advertising operator Russ registered through OOO 'Stinn'.
short: Tatyana Kim owns 65% of RVB; the other 35% belongs to the Russ structures (OOO Stinn).

source.name: Forbes Kazakhstan: Основательница Wildberries Татьяна Ким стала беднее на $2 млрд
source.note: Translation: 'Kim now owns 65% of the combined company RVB; the other 35% belongs to the Russ structures.' Same article: RVB LLC was founded by OOO Wildberries with a 65% share and OOO Stinn (owner of OOO Russ Outdoor).
source.quote: Сейчас Ким принадлежит 65% объединенной компании РВБ, остальные 35% принадлежат структурам Russ.

additionalSources.name: AK&M Information Agency: V.Bakalchuk has ceased to be a co-owner of Wildberries
additionalSources.quote: Vladislav Bakalchuk has ceased to be a co-owner of Wildberries LLC, now 100% of the company belongs to its founder Tatiana Kim.
